jobs.name: mage
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a replacement complete pixel-art character animation sheet in the EXACT coarse sprite style, compact proportions and low detail of the two reference images. Image 1 is the approved traveler: authoritative reference for head-to-body ratio, short legs, pixel density, chunky dark outline, warm palette, simple small face and game-world scale. Image 2 shows the original target character: retain its role, hair color, clothes and essential recognizable accessories, but redraw EACH ENTIRE BODY for anatomically correct opposing steps. These are reference images, not upper-body pixels to copy/paste. The previous attempt was rejected because it became tall, fine-detail concept art shrunk down; do NOT do that. Sprite body is only about 32 logical pixels wide and 47 logical pixels tall excluding hat/cat ears/accessories; massive head about 20-23 pixels tall, compact torso about 14 pixels tall, short legs about 13 pixels tall, total about 2.3 heads tall. Hat can add height without lengthening body. Coarse hard square pixel clusters, few colors, no antialiasing, no soft shading, no ornate trim, no fine textures, no realistic proportions. Draw as a genuinely low-resolution sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Exactly FOUR complete poses in equal cells in a strict TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW transparent sprite sheet. Same character, same head size and outfit, consistent body width, all facing LEFT, matched ground baseline, centered heads, no background, no text, no border, no labels, no particle effects. ROW-MAJOR poses: TOP LEFT = IDLE feet together relaxed; TOP RIGHT = WALK 1 with NEAR leg forward toward screen-left, FAR leg back toward screen-right, near arm back and far arm forward; BOTTOM LEFT = WALK 2 with FAR leg forward toward screen-left, NEAR leg back toward screen-right, near arm forward and far arm back; BOTTOM RIGHT = PURCHASE COMPLETE smile and free empty palm extended toward left, same stationary feet. Essential: NEAR leg brighter, FAR leg darker in ALL poses, and the brighter leg MUST switch from the LEFT side of the stride in WALK1 to the RIGHT side of the stride in WALK2. Leg overlap at hips and opposite arms must support that switch. DO NOT flip/mirror the entire figure and DO NOT change which leg has brighter skin. Both knees and boots clearly readable. All four poses fully contained in cells. Redraw full figure, never splice legs under an unchanged torso. Character is an adult depicted in compact stylized RPG proportions.
Target character: tired adult female mage with messy violet hair, clearly visible dark under-eye circles, a large floppy purple witch hat, simple belted purple robe/cape and a small book at hip, brown boots. Short robe hem allows opposite knees/boots to be read. Hat outline and body bulk closely match original reference; keep traveler-like compact body below hat. No extra stars, no earrings, no dangling jewelry.
Additional user direction: SIMPLIFY the design further. Around 16-24 total colors, two or three tones per material, large contiguous pixel clusters, very few isolated pixels. FACE simply 2-3 dark eye pixels and one small nose pixel. Avoid dense fine-grain details, delicate trims, gradients and realistic rendering. Prioritize the reference traveler's readable silhouette and compact body. Add ONE simple ochre/gold cuff stripe on the NEAR left boot only as a visual identity aid; FAR right boot has no stripe and a darker tone. In walking A the gold-cuffed boot must be at the screen-left front of the stride. In walking B the gold-cuffed boot must be at the screen-right rear of the stride and the plain DARK boot must be at screen-left front. This boot marker must NOT move to the other anatomical leg. Both exposed knee positions and arm counter-swings reverse as a coordinated whole-body pose. WALK B must visibly differ from WALK A in actual leg identity, not merely wider stride. Keep two distinct walk contacts with no in-between poses.
TARGETED REVISION for walk readability: use a SHORT purple coat over simple OPAQUE trousers instead of bare knees or a long robe. Both legs are fully clothed from hip to ankle, NO bare leg skin. Near LEFT trouser leg is LIGHT LILAC, far RIGHT trouser leg is DARK VIOLET; colors remain on same anatomical leg throughout. Top-right WALK1: light lilac leg stretches diagonally down-left, dark violet leg stretches diagonally down-right. Bottom-left WALK2: DARK VIOLET leg stretches diagonally down-left, LIGHT LILAC leg stretches diagonally down-right. This left/right inversion of colored trouser legs is REQUIRED. Coordinate counter-swing of arms and hip weight across the FULL BODY; retain compact face/head/hat scale in every cell. No added detailing. Image 2 is the current full-body concept target; simplify its lower costume into trousers to make leg identity unmistakable, while keeping the whole character coherent.
